column4: Dear EE TAs， I noticed some inconsistencies in how we grade the latest MATLAB assignments. Please remember to check not just the output plot but the matrix dimensions in their code. I've uploaded an automated grading script snippet to our course repo.

column3: How to balance coursework with TA duties in Machine Learning (IST)?
column4: Hi seniors! I just got accepted as a TA for the IST Machine Learning course. However， I am taking 5 upper-level courses this semester. Any tips on time management? How many hours per week do you usually spend on grading and answering student doubts?

column3: Wireshark Lab Error Workaround (TEM Communication Networks)
column4: For all TEM TAs handling the Communication Networks labs: many students are reporting a WinPcap interface error on Windows 11. I found a workaround: tell them to install Npcap instead and run Wireshark as Administrator. It saves so much debugging time during office hours!
